controls: Reuse joint-masked trees on identical fitting/audit rows; require training and audit prediction hash bridges. Keep frozen old full39 central and tree audit metrics as context, not matched treatment contrasts.
objective: Same mean-one sqrt(full_fit_count)/sample_fit_count per-row weights as trees, with fixed batch-size denominator; no weighted sampling, extra class weight, calibration or audit labels in fitting
budget: Three fresh MLP fits, 60 full epochs each, 48658680 examples and 95040 Adam updates in total; all models saved before audit; complete independent replay. Neural/tree compute and regularization are NOT matched.
diagnosis: Report original confusion matrices, all eight class metrics and false alerts; standardize fit/audit matrices to the same full-FIT class prior for generalization-gap comparisons; label joint-correctness oracle as unimplementable headroom only
selection: Final epoch only; intermediate fit-only snapshots do not select checkpoints. This bounded recipe is not an optimized comparison of model families.
